summary: Iteration 10 testing: DELETE /api/ideas (403 for non-owner, 200 for owner/creator, 404 for missing), POST /api/auth/change-password (wrong current -> 400, same new==current -> 400, valid change -> 200 and login with new pw works, restored back), PUT/GET /api/settings/notifications (in_app_* keys persist), in_app_assign=false suppresses assign notification, POST /api/workspaces + GET /api/bootstrap reflects new workspace, PATCH /api/tasks parent_id nest/promote incl. one-level clamp and null-clears-parent, PATCH start_date/due_date. UI smoke: workspace-switcher-btn + new-workspace-btn + workspace-name-input + workspace-save-btn work; Ideas drawer shows delete-idea-btn + delete-idea-confirm-btn; Settings has pw-current/new/confirm/save inputs; Bildirimler tab has notif-in_app_assign/comment/vote/idea switches + notif-save-btn; Gantt view has gantt-new-task-btn, gantt-assign-date-* on undated task, and after click a gantt-bar-* rendered (Tarih ata flow verified end-to-end). Backend 15/16 tests passed.

critical.issue: Missing privilege check: any authenticated member/regular user can create a workspace. Frontend hides new-workspace-btn for non-privileged users but backend accepts the request (returns 200). Expected 403 per is_privileged(user) gate, matching PATCH /api/workspaces/{id}.

update_organization at routes.py L1339 has NO @router decorator. It sits directly after the change_password return statement (L1338) — the function is defined but never registered as a route, so the Ayarlar > Organizasyon 'Güncelle' action cannot hit the backend. Add @router.patch("/organization") above async def update_organization.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / <Description> — a11y warning in console for these Radix dialogs. Not a blocker.

action_items: Add is_privileged(user) check + 403 to POST /api/workspaces (parity with PATCH /api/workspaces/{id}).
Re-add the missing @router.patch('/organization') decorator above update_organization in routes.py (currently orphaned right after change_password's return line).
Consider adding aria-describedby / Description to workspace-create Dialog and Idea drawer Dialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.

Seed script only re-seeds the OWNER password on subsequent startups; demo users (elif/mert/zeynep) are NOT re-created or password-reset if missing. In this preview env those users did not exist; testing agent had to insert them directly to run permission tests. Consider making seed idempotent for demo users too (upsert with password refresh).
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py L1338-1339: update_organization function is defined without a @router decorator right after change_password's return — the endpoint is silently missing. Any UI trying to PATCH the org name will 404/405. HIGH severity, easy fix.
routes.py L298 create_workspace: no privilege gate — mismatched with the frontend rule that only owner/admin should create workspaces. Backend must enforce.
routes.py L461-470 update_task parent_id handling: correctly uses data-key check to distinguish None-clear vs unset, and clamps to grandparent when nesting under a subtask — verified via API tests.
routes.py L497-503 promote_subtask: sets parent_id=None and appends to end of its status column (order=count). Works. Consider also recomputing order of remaining siblings for cleanliness (optional).
routes.py L150 create_notification correctly reads in_app_<type>; verified suppression when in_app_assign=false.
routes.py L666-676 delete_idea: owner/admin/creator gate correct; also cleans up comments and broadcasts.

success_rate.backend: 15/16 = 93.75% (only failure is a genuine bug: POST /api/workspaces accepts members)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-10 selectors present and functional (workspace switcher/create, idea delete btn+confirm, password inputs, in-app notif switches, gantt new-task/assign-date, Tarih ata -> gantt-bar renders)

rca of the issue: N/A for iteration-10 features (all worked). RCA for the two backend bugs discovered: (1) POST /api/workspaces was written without an is_privileged gate — mirror of PATCH /api/workspaces/{id} was likely intended; (2) update_organization function body was pasted immediately after change_password's `return {"ok": True}` line and its @router.patch('/organization') decorator was lost (or never added) — a lint pass would not catch this because the function is syntactically valid Python, just never wired up. Recommend adding a smoke test that hits every @router.<method> path with a HEAD/OPTIONS during CI to catch orphaned handlers.
